Class SlotHandle

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.window.WindowHandle
com.trevlar.menukit.api.window.SlotHandle
public final class SlotHandle extends WindowHandle
A typed handle on a slot, vanilla or created: the slot verbs, plus the generic WindowHandle.set(BehaviorKey, Decl) substrate. The slot author's server rules are gate(SlotGate) and binding(boolean); the operations are set by key (set(BehaviorKeys.SHIFT_CLICK_IN, TriBool.FALSE)). The client-observed reactions (ReactiveHook) and visibility have sugar here too.
